text:
oncall-bot: Handoff notice: scheduled shift change detected. Active incident INC-5032 (API p95 latency spike). Current autoscaling in progress. Paging is temporarily suppressed for 2m to allow handoff. Please ack and assign primary/secondary and comms owner.

Devon: ack — I'm wrapping up investigation. Latest: error rate is down, p95 still ~1.2s on search endpoint (/v1/search). I configured a temporary route to the warm pool. Handing drive to Maria for the next 30m (have a 10-min meeting).

Maria: taking primary. I'll be comms owner and own customer updates. Leaving secondary? @Sara are you able to be secondary for the next hour? :wave:

Sara: I can be secondary for the next hour. Will monitor dashboards and take on-call pages if they come through. Quick note: runbook step 2 has a typo (cache flush command) — I'll fix after this. :ok_hand:

Jamal: +1 on Maria primary. Also raising that Dedicated pool utilization hit 92% at spike peak, which could explain slower KV cache refill. If we need immediate relief, we can temporarily increase dedicated_burst to 1.5x — requires ops approval but we can do it.

Devon: what I did so far:
```
# checked tail of inference pods for kv-cache pressure
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=inference --tail=200 | grep KVCache
# confirmed routing change to warm pool
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/routing -d '{"route":"warm-pool","weight":1}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

Maria: thanks. For customer comms I'll post a short status to the incident channel and ping CS. Draft: "We're seeing elevated p95 on API search for some customers. Error rates are stable. Teams are routing to warm pool and monitoring. Will update in 20m or earlier." Any objections?

Sara: looks good. Add note that we tried a cache refresh and are watching autoscaler.

Jamal: if latency doesn't improve in 20m, recommend we roll back the last model version deployed to the cluster (v2026-03-13b) — that's in the rollback section of runbook. I can prep the rollback steps.

Maria: acknowledged. I'll take comms and keep whoever's on-call looped. Devon, please drop any runbook snippets or temp tokens in the incident thread if needed.

Devon: pinging controlplane logs and will add a quick blurb to the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-p95 — updated with what I tried.

oncall-bot: Assignment update: primary=Maria, secondary=Sara, comms_owner=Maria, driver_history=[Devon -> Maria]. Paging re-enabled. :white_check_mark:

Maria: posting external update to CS and incident channel now. If I need escalation, I'll page oncall-sre. Everyone, please react with :eyes: when you have this thread visible so we know coverage is confirmed.

Sara: :eyes:

Jamal: :eyes:

Devon: :eyes: — leaving now. Thanks team.

Maria: thanks Devon. I'll update in 18m with metrics snapshot and next steps.
